name: Atlantis (STS-34)
about: Atlantis (STS-34) (1989-084A), a crewed vehicle (OV-104), launched 1989 Oct 18. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1989 Oct 20), held fixed
GCAT names the site (EAFB RW23); its coordinates are written from memory
